thread:
sam (cust-prod): Hey — we just saw a batch of API errors from our service. Clients get JSON parse errors when calling /v1/generate with json_mode. Example error: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 123 (char 122).

maria (support): Sorry about that. Can you paste the raw response body and request id?

sam (cust-prod): sure
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"mode":"json", "prompt":"..."}'

Response (raw):
{"items":[{"id":1,"label":"ok"}]}/*trace:route=smart/variant=quant-ev1 ts=1947654320*/

maria (support): Ah that looks like an inline comment/annotation appended to the JSON — that will break strict parsers. Did you have smart routing enabled?

sam (cust-prod): yes, we use smart_routing=on; we also saw a latency spike right before errors. Billing also spiked due to retries. request_id: r-9c4b

alex (eng-runtime): Interesting — runtime has a debug annotation feature that can attach opaque trace blocks for routed requests when fallback triggers. It should not be applied inside json_mode responses. Can you share the model variant in headers (x-redwood-model)?

sam (cust-prod): header shows x-redwood-model: open/llama-quant-ev1

jin (sre): Checking routing logs now — I see a handoff at 1947654320 where preferred variant was unavailable and request fell back to `quant-ev1` via smart-fallback. Routing log snippet:
```
route_decision: smart_routing
fallback_reason: capacity_unavailable
fallback_variant: quant-ev1
debug_attach_trace: true
```

alex (eng-runtime): there's the problem — debug_attach_trace flagged true for fallback flows. It's a recent change to help infra debugging but we accidentally let the annotation serializer write inline comments even in json_mode. Should be an opt-in header only.

maria (support): Temporary mitigation: set header `X-Redwood-Strict-Schema: true` or `X-Redwood-Disable-Fallback: true` to force strict routing. That fixes the immediate parse failures for the customer.

sam (cust-prod): confirming — added `X-Redwood-Disable-Fallback: true` and parse errors stopped. Thanks, but billing already charged for retries — any refund process?

maria (support): I'll open a billing ticket for refunds and reduce rate-limiting thresholds while we debug. Ticket #BILL-4521.

alex (eng-runtime): Follow-up plan: 1) patch runtime to never inject inline trace annotations into JSON-mode responses; 2) require debug_attach_trace only when header `X-Redwood-Debug-Traces: allow` is present; 3) add unit tests for json_mode + fallback; 4) add a sanity-check in router to prevent non-JSON-safe metadata for json_mode responses. I'll create an issue and PR. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/issues/1227

jin (sre): I'll push a temporary config to disable debug_attach_trace on prod routing pools for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: rolled config redwood-routing/debug_attach_trace -> disabled on pool eu-west-1 at 1947654365

sam (cust-prod): confirmed errors gone for the last 10 minutes. Thanks everyone :pray:

maria (support): leaving this thread open until PR lands. assigning to @alex for the fix. :thumbsup:
